posts.cooked:
Those numbers are correct according to the wiki and the rulebook which came with Shattered Timelines.

From my experience, in play La Captain can range from a 1 to a 3 depending on her starting draw so don't let the 2 fool you into thinking she's a pushover. Kismet on the other hand, I don't think I've ever lost to her so that 2 seems generous. I put her down there with Baron Blade at a 1. Maybe when I get the chance to play her more she'll surprise me.
